scope: Exploratory previously viewed seven-person cohort. Earlier individual CGM labels required. Source provenance checked; physical CGM/chest clock still assumed. No source shifts or raw feature replacement.
weight_definition: Each person has equal total weight; each observed class has equal total within person. Point weights uniform within class. Run weights equalize positive contiguous low runs and negative six-hour wall-clock blocks. Brief positive runs retained; not only confirmed15min events.
inner_split: Earlier75% of outer training for fit, later25% for selection and out-of-fit stack scores;60min input and15min label purge. Highest person-macro inner AP. All candidates retained.
stack: Fixed logisticC0.1 on three selected modality logits plus modality flags and clock; missing logit0. Trained only on inner held-out base predictions; base models then refit to full outer train. Refit distribution change is a limitation. No validation/test labels fit stack.
outer_split: Same v2.1 60/20/20 purged anchors and crossing-event exclusions
availability: Unchanged full-wrist gate forPPG/EDA; existing complete/validECG gate forECG; union for early/late/control. Single-modality end-to-end arms retain all reference events. Common-wrist view also masks missingECG forECG-only arm; comparisons only on identical score masks.
selection: Pooled earlier validation macroeventrecall maximum under pooled falsealerts/day budget; ties fewerFA,policyorder,higherthreshold. Freeze all selections before test scores.
